QuestionStmt.S: Identify the product formed from chlorobenzene on heating with conc. $HNO_3$ in presence of conc. $H_2SO_4$.

Solution.S:
Chlorobenzene undergoes electrophilic aromatic substitution. The chlorine atom is ortho/para-directing but deactivating. On nitration with concentrated HNO₃/H₂SO₄, it forms a mixture of ortho- and para-nitrochlorobenzene. The ortho product (1-chloro-2-nitrobenzene) and para product (1-chloro-4-nitrobenzene) are obtained, with para being slightly major due to steric effects. No meta product is formed under these conditions. Trinitration does not occur under normal nitration conditions; that would require more forcing conditions.

Thus, the correct answer is Option C: Mixture of 1-chloro-4-nitrobenzene and 1-chloro-2-nitrobenzene.
